attributes.description:
The base estimator from which the ensemble is grown.

.. versionadded:: 1.2
   `base_estimator_` was renamed to `estimator_`.
attributes.name: estimator_

attributes.description:
Number of features seen during :term:`fit`.

.. versionadded:: 0.24
attributes.name: n_features_in_

attributes.description:
Names of features seen during :term:`fit`. Defined only when `X`
has feature names that are all strings.

.. versionadded:: 1.0
attributes.name: feature_names_in_

attributes.description: The collection of fitted base estimators.
attributes.name: estimators_

attributes.description:
The subset of drawn samples (i.e., the in-bag samples) for each base
estimator. Each subset is defined by an array of the indices selected.
attributes.name: estimators_samples_

attributes.description: The subset of drawn features for each base estimator.
attributes.name: estimators_features_

attributes.description:
Score of the training dataset obtained using an out-of-bag estimate.
This attribute exists only when ``oob_score`` is True.
attributes.name: oob_score_

attributes.description:
Decision function computed with out-of-bag estimate on the training
set. If n_estimators is small it might be possible that a data point
was never left out during the bootstrap. In this case,
`oob_decision_function_` might contain NaN. This attribute exists
only when ``oob_score`` is True.
attributes.name: oob_decision_function_

methods.name: decision_function
methods.summary: Average of the decision functions of the base classifiers.

methods.name: fit
methods.summary: Build a Bagging ensemble of estimators from the training set (X, y).

methods.name: get_metadata_routing
methods.summary: Get metadata routing of this object.

methods.name: score
methods.summary: Return :ref:`accuracy <accuracy_score>` on provided data and labels.

methods.name: set_fit_request
methods.summary: Configure whether metadata should be requested to be passed to the ``fit`` method.

methods.name: set_params
methods.summary: Set the parameters of this estimator.

methods.name: set_score_request
methods.summary: Configure whether metadata should be requested to be passed to the ``score`` method.

parameters.description:
The base estimator to fit on random subsets of the dataset.
If None, then the base estimator is a
:class:`~sklearn.tree.DecisionTreeClassifier`.

.. versionadded:: 1.2
   `base_estimator` was renamed to `estimator`.
parameters.name: estimator

parameters.description: The number of base estimators in the ensemble.
parameters.name: n_estimators

parameters.description:
The number of samples to draw from X to train each base estimator (with
replacement by default, see `bootstrap` for more details).

- If None, then draw `X.shape[0]` samples irrespective of `sample_weight`.
- If int, then draw `max_samples` samples.
- If float, then draw `max_samples * X.shape[0]` unweighted samples or
  `max_samples * sample_weight.sum()` weighted samples.
parameters.name: max_samples

parameters.description:
The number of features to draw from X to train each base estimator (
without replacement by default, see `bootstrap_features` for more
details).

- If int, then draw `max_features` features.
- If float, then draw `max(1, int(max_features * n_features_in_))` features.
parameters.name: max_features

parameters.description:
Whether samples are drawn with replacement. If False, sampling without
replacement is performed. If fitting with `sample_weight`, it is
strongly recommended to choose True, as only drawing with replacement
will ensure the expected frequency semantics of `sample_weight`.
parameters.name: bootstrap

parameters.description: Whether features are drawn with replacement.
parameters.name: bootstrap_features

parameters.description:
Whether to use out-of-bag samples to estimate
the generalization error. Only available if bootstrap=True.
parameters.name: oob_score

parameters.description:
When set to True, reuse the solution of the previous call to fit
and add more estimators to the ensemble, otherwise, just fit
a whole new ensemble. See :term:`the Glossary <warm_start>`.

.. versionadded:: 0.17
   *warm_start* constructor parameter.
parameters.name: warm_start

parameters.description:
The number of jobs to run in parallel for both :meth:`fit` and
:meth:`predict`. ``None`` means 1 unless in a
:obj:`joblib.parallel_backend` context. ``-1`` means using all
processors. See :term:`Glossary <n_jobs>` for more details.
parameters.name: n_jobs

parameters.description:
Controls the random resampling of the original dataset
(sample wise and feature wise).
If the base estimator accepts a `random_state` attribute, a different
seed is generated for each instance in the ensemble.
Pass an int for reproducible output across multiple function calls.
See :term:`Glossary <random_state>`.
parameters.name: random_state
parameters.type_doc: int, RandomState instance or None, default=None

parameters.description: Controls the verbosity when fitting and predicting.
parameters.name: verbose

signature: BaggingClassifier(estimator=None, n_estimators=10, *, max_samples=None, max_features=1.0, bootstrap=True, bootstrap_features=False, oob_score=False, warm_start=False, n_jobs=None, random_state=None, verbose=0)
